findings.title: Profile bio rendered as raw HTML
findings.rationale: The bio is passed to dangerouslySetInnerHTML without sanitising. The bio is user-supplied text.
findings.failure_scenario: A bio containing a script tag runs in the session of every user who views the profile.

findings.title: Effect fetch has no cleanup, so a late response can overwrite newer data
findings.rationale: The request has no abort or ignore flag. When userId changes quickly, an older response can call setProfile after the newer one.

findings.title: Hook called after an early return
findings.rationale: useMemo runs only when profile is set. Calling it after the early return breaks the rules of hooks and throws when the order of hooks changes between renders.

findings.title: Analytics key shipped in the client bundle
findings.rationale: The key is a constant in client code, so every visitor can read and reuse it.

input.summary: Four issues: unsafe HTML, a fetch race, a hook after an early return and a client key.
